problem.title: Sum of Nodes at Odd Levels
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree whose nodes contain integer values, determine the sum of the values of all nodes present at odd-numbered levels.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the node values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
